proves: Explicit actor termination: Actor.exit(0) (normal reason) silently removes the actor -- no stderr, program exits 0. The ask to the dead actor returns nil (the flush processes work() then die() in mailbox order; get() then finds no live actor). SPEC2 8.7 says explicit shutdown is planned and today actors stop 'when they fail or when their supervisor shuts them down' -- Actor.exit is the actual in-language exit surface, and its post-mortem observable is ask -> nil.
